description: Send Picodev a meeting request. contact: {name, email, company?, phone?}. context: the project in a few sentences (2000 characters at most): what the visitor wants to do, where they stand, what they did in the lab. availabilities: 1 to 10 slots {from, to}, ISO 8601 dates with a time zone, within the next 60 days; or {text}, one sentence ("Tuesday mornings"). Requires consent=true. session and agent_token, optional: the mail also says what the visitor did in the lab. Before passing consent=true, show the visitor the consent text in the visitor's language, and wait until they accept it. In French: "J'accepte que mes coordonnées et la description de mon projet soient envoyées à Picodev par courriel, pour qu'ils me répondent. Picodev les garde 3 ans après le dernier échange et ne les utilise pour rien d'autre. Détails : lab.picodev.fr/confidentialite" In English: "I agree that my contact details and the description of my project are sent to Picodev by e-mail, so that they can answer me. Picodev keeps them for 3 years after our last exchange and uses them for nothing else. Details: lab.picodev.fr/en/privacy" Returns {sent, next}: Picodev answers by e-mail to confirm a slot.
name: request_meeting
title: Request a meeting with Picodev
